flow.transformation: mkdtemp without success-path cleanup; subprocess timeout escapes before cleanup

findings.impact: Each ordinary run retains an installed dependency tree; timeout/spawn failure also leaks owned scratch. Directory symlink additionally imposed an unnecessary host privilege requirement.
findings.resolution: Clean owned dependencies in parser finally and install spawn/timeout handling; preserve externally supplied dependencies; invoke fixed ESM helper from dependency cwd with JSON stdin, avoiding symlink creation.
